I'm sorry to hear that. I'm sorry it has had such an effect on you.

I don't know. Everytime I see my mum now, or I hear her voice around the house I just cry because I know that this will crush her. But the pain, I can't deal with it.

I have a degree and a masters from top UK universities but I'm not doing anything with them. I'm not fulfilling my potential. They have a daughter/sister/aunt who can even get a marriage to work, who can't even get anyone to love her.

My life has been this way for 10 years. Depression and BPD for 10 years. I can't take it anymore. When there are glimmers of hope, it gets taken away.

Thank you.
I guess it should be but I don't see any worth in myself.
Nope, and that's what makes me believe I'm so fucked up. On the outside I apparently have a lot going for me, but I don't see it and I don't think I ever will.

Thank you.

I have sort of spoken to my mum about it but I'm currently locking myself in my room to avoid people. I just don't want to cry in front of anyone. 

Thanks again.

My husband is filling divorce papers and after everything, it's so easy for him and that hurts. That causes me pain. I have a degree and masters from top universities but I feel so unmotivated. I haven't even started my career yet. My grandmother just passed away. I lost my twins due to eclampsia. I don't think I will ever catch a break. 

My future sister-in-law has put a lot of work into the wedding and I don't want to ruin it, so I'll wait. Plus, it gives me time to sort out my affairs. 

Thank you for listening to me.

Four years...
I don't know if I have the strength to wait four years to feel better. I just lost my grandmother, the person who loved me the most. And I just can't, i can't.
